title: Verbalizing LLMs’ assumptions to explain and control sycophancy

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating social and factual sycophancy by eliciting the models' verbalized assumptions about user intent (e.g., validation-seeking vs. objectivity-seeking), training linear probes on model internal representations, and using activation steering to measure shifts in sycophantic responses on benchmarks like ELEPHANT, AITA, Cancer-Myth, and Factual QA.
